mechanism_prediction: gains must scale with block dimension: titan(768) > omics(275) > clinical(23). A uniform gain falsifies the estimation-variance mechanism.
pick_caveat: four estimators were scored per block on the pooled outcome; taking the best carries a selection term of about sd*sqrt(2*ln 4). The gated arm below inherits it and is a reference, not a reportable number.

C5_gated_fusion.note: the gating weights here are read off the SAME pooled outcome they are scored on, so this is an oracle-flavoured reference for whether gating is worth building in-fold, not an arm. Its control says how much the structure alone buys.
